note: Lolo NF campground on an open, sunny bench above Fishtrap Lake (non-motorized boating), reached from Thompson Falls via the paved Thompson River Rd, 14 miles of Fishtrap Creek Rd #516 and 2 miles of narrow FR #7593. Sites reported to ~24 ft (Campendium/The Dyrt). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the FS page (updated Oct 13, 2026): free, FCFS only, RV pull-throughs. Added season (2026: May 12 - Oct 13), vault toilets, hand-pump potable water. Cleared the aggregator-derived 24-ft max rig (FS gives no length). No current Lolo alert covers the access roads (the Deer Creek NFSR 236 closure is elsewhere). Note trimmed of restated values; added the narrow-road caveat.
